verdict.rationale: Slack integration sends task artifact updates to team channels (docs-4), and tasks support shared comments/review history (docs-5, docs-28), plus GitHub/Jira/Linear links back to source tickets — giving developers visibility into task progress and completion. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of a notification specifically triggered when an agent 'needs my input' (e.g., approval-request alerts), which is central to the story. missing for 10: dedicated approval/needs-input notification docs, independent hands-on confirmation that notifications actually fire reliably.
